data: Tesla's fiscal 2025 revenue was about $94.8 billion, down roughly 3% from $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024. I'm working from memory of the reported results rather than the 10-K itself, so the figures below are approximate. Gross profit was about $17 billion, which implies a gross margin of roughly 18%, up from about 17.9% in fiscal 2024. Operating income was about $4.4 billion, an operating margin of roughly 4.6%, down from $7.1 billion and 7.2% in fiscal 2024. Revenue and operating income are close to the reported totals. Gross profit is the least certain of the three, so please confirm the exact numbers in Tesla's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
